title: Returning joy without pledging future delight

captions.physics: Renewing pleasure through a meaningful wish
captions.emotions: Feeling hope for new shared experience

meaning: Free hope supports leisure when renewed pleasure leaves future delight and compulsory continuation free from becoming conditions of today’s agreement.
text: Returning to pleasure can revive large expectations. Judgement in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes responding to a meaningful wish to renew shared experience. The Devil in energy leans towards holding the other through promised continuation. The Star in emotions brings hope for new leisure together. Hope can support interest without guarantee. Both need room to leave a bright prospect free from becoming today’s condition of agreement. One free invitation can discover an actual response without obliging either person to want every subsequent meeting and possible pleasure beforehand.

For example, you remember favourite walks seeking amusing shop signs and suggest a small new route. Immediately arranging an entire series appeals. **Hope for continuation should not hold today’s agreement in place.** You can choose one walk and leave further plans open. Renewed pleasure gets a chance in the present. Both need no promise of permanent interest to enjoy today’s possibility freely and discover what appears along the way.

The difficulty is asking for more promises than a beginning needs. You clarify future plans and increasingly seek confirmation of continued involvement. Hope becomes a pledge. A freely chosen scale restores actual desire. Both can expect pleasure without contracting for unchanging delight. Renewal keeps meaning while future meetings remain possibilities each can choose again. Today’s walk can be valuable without securing the rest of the season.
